tasks.title: Independently freeze the current product GAP, simplification plan, and execution catalog
tasks.summary: Review the complete current-dev audit and freeze the exact 27-task functional closure plan before implementation begins.
acceptance: Verify source, runtime, frontend, hosted identity, and canonical task dedup findings against the exact plan PR head.
Validate 27 unique task IDs, acyclic dependencies, repository boundaries, and ordered path overlaps.
Confirm Source dev remains manual bounded one-tick only and no security or live-capital work entered the catalog.
Review code disposition coverage, publish exact-head review evidence, and merge the plan PR to dev.
validation: Markdown link and git diff checks
code_disposition: Confirm every implementation task has caller/disposition acceptance and no duplicate owner/store design.
tasks.rollout: Documentation and catalog only; completion releases implementation dependencies.
tasks.rollback: Revert the documentation merge and leave product/runtime unchanged.

tasks.title: Bound Source controller state growth and restore constant-cost readiness
tasks.summary: Remove recursive controller readback persistence, migrate oversized state, and make readiness bounded without enabling provider egress.
acceptance: Controller state persists bounded identities, counters, cursor, and terminal summaries without embedding prior state or full pre/post readbacks.
Existing oversized state is migrated or safely rebuilt while preserving connector, schedule, and terminal identity truth.
Ready and health probes return within a fixed budget with at least 260 connectors and current journal volume.
Evidence identifies canonical owner/store/callers and retires the recursive projection without creating a second state store.
validation: growth test across at least 100 ticks
code_disposition: Keep controller_worker as sole owner; replace recursive projection; audit old health full-scan callers.
tasks.rollout: Migrate state while controller remains reconcile-only, then restart Source API and verify bounded health.
tasks.rollback: Stop controller and remain reconcile-only; preserve old state backup for read-only diagnosis.

tasks.title: Add bounded paper lifecycle cursors and reject non-executable fleet children
tasks.summary: Stop repeated full-history lifecycle scans and prevent invalid RuntimeBindings from spawning resource-heavy paper workers.
acceptance: Lifecycle processing uses durable cursor/ack and bounded compaction or an equivalent append store; a worker never rescans all acknowledged history.
Fleet admission does not spawn a child for a binding missing execution-required artifact projection and publishes a typed functional reason.
Restart and replay preserve exactly-once effects while state size remains bounded under repeated stale signals.
Evidence audits static paper runtime, smoke strategy, fleet owner, lifecycle store, and removes only replacement-proven full-scan paths.
code_disposition: Keep dynamic fleet as sole owner; classify static runtime and smoke strategy as explicit compatibility/test paths.
tasks.rollout: Stop invalid children, migrate each lifecycle state, then restart only admitted workers.
tasks.rollback: Pause fleet with durable cursor preserved; never restore unbounded full-history scanning.

tasks.title: Make strict-live frontend reads and writes honest
tasks.summary: Remove production mock-completed mutations and silent seed fallback while retaining explicit demo/test fixtures.
acceptance: Strict-live with real writes disabled returns unavailable/disabled and never a completed receipt or success toast.
Strict-live HTTP or adapter contract mismatch remains typed unavailable/degraded and never invokes seedFn.
Explicit demo/test profile can still use fixtures without entering production chunks or transport selection.
Evidence inventories production callers across src/lib/bff and bff-v1 and records the consolidation target without a broad rewrite.
validation: write gate and management adapter tests
code_disposition: Keep runActionSafe; remove mock success and strict-live seed fallback; retain mocks as explicit fixtures.
tasks.rollout: Deploy as read-only strict-live behavior before enabling any real domain action.
tasks.rollback: Disable actions and show unavailable; do not restore simulated completion.

tasks.title: Complete the normal Registry to executable RuntimeBinding contract
tasks.summary: Carry immutable artifact storage identity and execution policy through normal owners instead of test-authored metadata.
out_of_scope: inline Object Store test dictionaries as product design
acceptance: Approved registry artifact ID/version/checksum/storage descriptor/interpreter and paper market policy reach DeploymentPlan and RuntimeBinding through normal commands.
Runtime Manager rejects active transition when the projection is missing, mismatched, or caller-authored without authority readback.
Canonical readback exposes the executable contract and downstream paper admission receipt.
Evidence proves reuse of existing registry/deployment/runtime owners and identifies any superseded metadata-only compatibility path.
code_disposition: Keep existing dispatcher, Runtime Manager, and loader; remove metadata shortcuts only after normal-path proof.
tasks.rollout: Require the new contract for newly activated paper bindings; migrate old bindings in E2E task.
tasks.rollback: Reject new activation and retain readable inactive plans; never accept incomplete active bindings.

tasks.title: Provide one canonical stored market snapshot contract for paper
tasks.summary: Implement the Source-side contract already referenced by the paper producer using stored normalized data, not continuous external pulling.
acceptance: One canonical endpoint/query returns the latest stored normalized snapshot with symbol, snapshot ID, event time, lineage, and closes.
Paper producer selects it by RuntimeBinding policy and refuses stale/missing data with a typed reason.
Reading a snapshot performs zero provider egress and cannot start a scheduler.
Evidence audits all snapshot clients/providers and removes or aliases duplicate endpoint contracts to the single owner.
validation: producer integration and stale snapshot tests
code_disposition: Use Source authority as sole snapshot owner; do not add a parallel feed or retain conflicting URL contracts.
tasks.rollout: Serve stored snapshots read-only before paper workers consume them.
tasks.rollback: Producer reports market_input_unavailable and emits no signal; no fallback to fixed closes.

tasks.title: Wire Workshop messages to the existing reconstruction engine through a durable worker
tasks.summary: Turn admitted Workshop conversation into durable reconstruction result and Registry draft without a second engine.
acceptance: Workshop message transaction durably admits one reconstruction job with conversation/version identity.
A leased worker invokes the existing reconstruction implementation, persists result, and creates or updates a canonical Registry draft.
Replay, stale result, crash, and restart preserve one effective result and next-best question.
Evidence inventories reconstruct endpoint/engine/callers and consolidates them into one worker path.
code_disposition: Keep existing reconstruction algorithm and Workshop store; retire direct-only normal path after worker proof.
tasks.rollout: Enable worker after its durable queue and Registry readback are healthy.
tasks.rollback: Pause worker and retain admitted jobs; Workshop remains readable and explicitly pending.

tasks.title: Drain Agora Research outbox with the existing ResearchDispatcher
tasks.summary: Add the missing production consumer for durable stages and candidate projection without creating another dispatcher.
acceptance: A leased production consumer calls existing ResearchDispatcher.execute_stage for admitted outbox rows and persists ordered progress/results.
Real artifacts create lineage-backed candidates; unavailable inputs create an empty pool with explicit reasons, never default fixtures.
Duplicate delivery, partial failure, restart, and stale stage completion are idempotent.
Evidence identifies the previously test-only dispatcher and removes any facade-only success path made redundant by the consumer.
code_disposition: Keep one dispatcher and one outbox; delete or fail-close facade-only completion after consumer proof.
tasks.rollout: Enable adapters individually; unavailable adapters remain explicit degraded/empty.
tasks.rollback: Pause consumer with backlog durable; never restore hard-coded candidates.

tasks.title: Produce authoritative Agora pool, decision, widget, and performance projections
tasks.summary: Connect existing candidate, trading-room, decision, telemetry, and performance stores with production producers.
acceptance: Strategy/version resolves one current candidate pool and workspace identity; lens is a view recipe, not a pool ID.
Candidate review and domain outcomes produce durable decision events through existing store contracts.
Paper/telemetry outcomes produce performance rows, suggestions, and data for every active widget or explicit unavailable state.
Evidence inventories direct test-only store callers and establishes one production producer per projection without duplicate stores.
code_disposition: Keep existing stores; wire producers; do not create widget-local authorities.
tasks.rollout: Publish projections behind existing Agora read contracts before frontend cutover.
tasks.rollback: Stop producers and expose stale/unavailable; never synthesize rows.

tasks.title: Route Management commands to real domain owners and terminal readback
tasks.summary: Replace generic admission-only success with explicit domain command routing for the existing production action call sites.
acceptance: Every current production Management action is mapped to an existing domain owner or explicitly unavailable; no generic fake completion remains.
Accepted commands expose command ID, domain receipt, terminal status, and authoritative readback or typed failure.
Idempotency and replay do not duplicate domain effects.
Evidence inventories all action kinds, owners, duplicate adapters, and removes admission-only paths only after route proof.
code_disposition: Keep command executor as router; reuse domain clients; do not implement mutations inside BFF.
tasks.rollout: Enable paper/dev actions by domain after each owner readback passes.
tasks.rollback: Mark affected action unavailable; do not return admitted as completed.

tasks.title: Expose real Formula, activity, paper telemetry, and postmortem read models
tasks.summary: Complete the backend data contracts required to remove four synthetic Management surfaces.
out_of_scope: new analytics engine when an owner exists
acceptance: Formula jobs expose admitted/running/terminal metrics and chart lineage from a real backend job owner.
Activity, strategy paper telemetry, and postmortem list/detail project canonical events/stores with typed empty/unavailable states.
All contracts include source identity, freshness, and degradation instead of static rows.
Evidence identifies existing read stores and consolidates overlapping BFF endpoints rather than creating parallel datasets.
code_disposition: Reuse existing audit, telemetry, postmortem, and job owners; remove duplicate BFF projections after consumer migration.
tasks.rollout: Publish read models before frontend removes synthetic data.
tasks.rollback: Return typed unavailable/empty; never fall back to fixed rows.

tasks.title: Make Management AI return an actual provider answer with bounded degradation
tasks.summary: Repair the existing OpenClaw-backed NL path so gateway reachability is not mistaken for answer readiness.
out_of_scope: development task creation through product BFF
acceptance: Provider readiness reflects a successful bounded answer call, not only gateway connectivity.
Expired/unrefreshable provider session selects an already-configured functional fallback or returns typed degraded within the deadline.
Conversation persistence and correlation survive restart and do not duplicate assistant turns.
Evidence inventories provider adapters/fallbacks and keeps one Management NL orchestration path.
code_disposition: Keep existing NL endpoint and conversation store; consolidate provider readiness and remove misleading outer-only success.
tasks.rollout: Enable provider only after bounded answer probe passes; retain explicit degraded state otherwise.
tasks.rollback: Disable provider calls and keep persisted conversations readable; no synthetic answer.

tasks.title: Provide a safe bounded manual one-tick Source pull for dev acceptance
tasks.summary: Keep dev external ingestion off by default and make test-time pull an explicit selected one-shot controller action.
acceptance: Default dev controller mode remains reconcile_only and attempts zero provider egress.
Inspect and reuse or rebase the already-green PR #5064 candidate when its exact head remains compatible; do not create a second independent implementation.
An explicit command selects allowlisted connector IDs, runs exactly one bounded reconcile-and-pull tick, and exits with terminal readback.
Failure or completion cannot leave a recurring pull process; concurrent/replayed command is bounded and idempotent.
Evidence audits legacy scheduler utilities and consolidates the retained one-shot entrypoint onto the canonical controller.
code_disposition: Keep one controller; retain at most one one-shot utility; never restore scheduler_worker as normal daemon.
tasks.rollout: Install command while scheduler remains stopped/reconcile-only; invoke only inside named acceptance runs.
tasks.rollback: Remove/disable manual command and remain reconcile-only.

tasks.title: Connect the active Agora UI to real reconstruction, pools, decisions, and widgets
tasks.summary: Replace fixed lens identity and page-local review state with existing authoritative BFF contracts.
acceptance: Workshop message shows durable reconstruction progress/result and canonical StrategySpec identity.
Trading Room resolves current pool/workspace and never passes lens-A..E as candidate pool ID.

Active review reuses the shared BFF-wired drawer already present on current dev, does not recreate stale PR #569 work, and readbacks decision; all widgets show real projection or explicit unavailable.
Evidence identifies and removes the page-local duplicate only after shared component journey proof.
code_disposition: Adopt shared CandidateReviewDrawer; remove fixed production lenses and page-local duplicate after proof.
tasks.rollout: Deploy against backend contracts in strict-live mode.
tasks.rollback: Show pending/unavailable and keep records readable; no local fallback decisions.

tasks.title: Replace synthetic Management panels with real read models and domain receipts
tasks.summary: Wire Formula Studio, Activity Monitor, paper/live telemetry, postmortems, and action pages to canonical BFF truth.
acceptance: Four named synthetic surfaces use real BFF contracts and render typed empty/degraded states without seed/hash/timer/static rows.
Action pages display admitted versus terminal accurately and refresh authoritative entity readback.
Read-only build disables unavailable actions without success toasts.
Evidence audits all production mock imports in the touched surfaces and removes replacement-proven code.
code_disposition: Remove synthetic implementations after real contract proof; keep reusable rendering components and explicit test fixtures.
tasks.rollout: Deploy strict-live with real writes disabled first, then enable only proven dev-paper actions.
tasks.rollback: Show unavailable/empty; never restore synthetic live labels.

tasks.title: Execute all declared Management AI UI actions through existing registries
tasks.summary: Complete openDrawer, focusPanel, and confirmed runBffAction routing while preserving read-only kernel behavior.
acceptance: All seven registered action kinds either execute through existing route/drawer/focus registries or return explicit unsupported.
runBffAction flows through existing confirmation and domain action receipt/readback, never direct mutation.
Provider answer action correlation persists and replay does not execute twice.
Evidence proves one UI action registry and removes duplicate switch/placeholder routes made redundant.
code_disposition: Keep existing registry and confirmation components; consolidate action switches rather than add a second dispatcher.
tasks.rollout: Enable navigation actions first; enable dev-paper domain action only after backend terminal readback.
tasks.rollback: Disable individual action with explicit reason; keep conversation usable.

tasks.title: Bound functional Management BFF read latency and payload cost
tasks.summary: Remove repeated fan-out/full scans causing multi-second core Management reads without creating a general performance program.
acceptance: Cockpit, persona fleet, and data-sources reads avoid repeated downstream/full-store work through bounded query/projection/caching semantics.
Freshness and degradation remain visible; cache cannot turn stale/missing source into healthy data.
A representative current dataset meets documented functional latency and payload budgets.
Evidence inventories duplicate queries/projections and removes redundant work rather than adding another cache authority.
code_disposition: Reuse canonical stores and BFF projections; consolidate duplicate fan-out and full scans.
tasks.rollout: Enable bounded projections per endpoint and compare readback/freshness.
tasks.rollback: Disable optimization while retaining typed degraded response; do not hide slow dependencies with seed data.

tasks.title: Integrate repaired functional owners into one dev Compose topology
tasks.summary: Own the only docker-compose change for this program and preserve manual-only Source plus paper-only execution.
acceptance: Compose defaults Source to reconcile_only and exposes manual one-tick only through explicit operator command.
Reconstruction, Research consumer, paper admission/snapshot, Management reads/actions, and AI provider have exact owner URLs/state volumes/health wiring.
Only executable paper bindings can spawn and no live-capital service is enabled.
Evidence audits legacy profiles and removes only those with zero current caller after replacement topology proof.
code_disposition: Keep one Compose owner per domain; retire conflicting legacy profiles only after caller audit.
tasks.rollout: Restart affected dev services in dependency order with Source pull disabled.
tasks.rollback: Return to prior images/config while leaving Source scheduler stopped and paper/live capital disabled.

tasks.title: Prove Loops 1 through 4 from one bounded manual Source pull
tasks.summary: Run current deployed owners from one explicitly selected external pull through Distillation, Alpha, and Teaching.
acceptance: Test explicitly starts one selected bounded Source tick and proves the pull process exits or returns to reconcile-only.
The resulting SourceRecord naturally enters the existing Distillation queue and reaches Registry StrategySpec, Alpha run, and Teaching terminal/readback.
All identities originate inside the run; no prebuilt IDs, tmp stores, fake providers, or direct downstream inserts are accepted.
Evidence records last successful boundary, first failure, and confirms no duplicate Source/Distillation owner was introduced.
code_disposition: Reclassify any manual-downstream or misnamed component tests; retain useful fixtures outside closure gate.
tasks.rollout: Run only in named dev acceptance window, then verify external pulling is off.
tasks.rollback: Stop one-shot command and preserve partial records/report; do not keep retrying externally.

tasks.title: Prove deployed Loops 5 through 7 with real Agora, policy, Research, and Consultation owners
tasks.summary: Replace in-process/fake proof with a durable current-dev human-learning journey.
acceptance: One current-dev run creates Agora evidence/dataset, durable policy handoff, imitation candidate, Research receipt, Consultation memo, and Governance receipt.
Only deployed URLs/workers and durable stores are used; no fabricated terminal memo or direct store call is accepted.
Restart/replay preserves identities and no duplicate candidate/consult result appears.
Evidence confirms durable handoff is the sole automatic policy discovery path.
code_disposition: Retain existing handoff drainer/executor; mark direct DB discovery for retirement after proof.
tasks.rollout: Run against current dev provider and paper environment.
tasks.rollback: Pause workers with durable backlog; never switch to fake provider.

tasks.title: Prove deployed Loops 8 through 12 from normal approval and deployment
tasks.summary: Create an executable binding through normal product commands and complete paper execution, telemetry, reconciliation, and evolution.
acceptance: Normal approval/deployment creates an executable binding with authority-derived artifact projection and current stored snapshot policy.
Existing nine invalid bindings are retired/redeployed/migrated through canonical APIs before fleet acceptance.
One paper run produces signal, order, fill, position, heartbeat, telemetry, drift/incident, postmortem/evolution decision and downstream receipt.
Evidence proves bounded lifecycle cursor/resource behavior and no compatibility runtime or smoke strategy handled the product run.
code_disposition: Keep product E2E free of inline fixtures; classify isolated fixture tests separately.
tasks.rollout: Retire invalid children, activate one executable paper binding, and observe full chain.
tasks.rollback: Deactivate paper binding and preserve readback; no live execution fallback.

tasks.title: Prove the complete Agora user journey in the active frontend
tasks.summary: Drive Workshop through reconstruction, Research, Trading Room, decision, performance, learning, and consultation in strict-live UI.
acceptance: Browser creates all journey inputs and observes canonical IDs after every write from Workshop through Consultation.
Trading Room uses real pool/workspace and shared drawer; decision/performance survive reload.
No fixture, seed, prebuilt ID, or in-memory-only mutation appears in network or bundle evidence.
Evidence records any UI duplicate removed only after replacement journey passes.
code_disposition: Confirm page-local drawer/fixed lens paths are no longer production callers.
tasks.rollout: Run against Pantheon-owned dev frontend/BFF candidate.
tasks.rollback: Keep UI read-only/degraded; no mock fallback.

tasks.title: Prove Management and Management AI real read/action journeys
tasks.summary: Validate real data panels, domain receipts, provider answers, UI actions, and reload readback in strict-live mode.
acceptance: Formula, activity, paper telemetry, and postmortem pages show backend-origin data or typed unavailable without synthetic content.
A supported dev-paper action progresses admitted to domain terminal and remains after reload; read-only profile is honestly disabled.
Management AI returns an actual provider answer and executes navigation/drawer/focus plus one confirmed domain action exactly once.
Evidence includes latency samples, network provenance, and zero production seed imports for exercised surfaces.

tasks.rollout: Run against Pantheon-owned dev exact candidate with paper-only actions.
tasks.rollback: Disable writes/provider actions and show typed unavailable; no simulated success.

tasks.title: Project one stimulus-driven cross-loop run into current Management truth
tasks.summary: Verify all twelve loop owners, worker failures, terminal outputs, and next receipts from newly generated identities.
acceptance: One run generates all source identities and proves owner trigger, terminal, authority readback, next receipt, and Management row for twelve loops.
Loops 8, 9, and 12 publish current owner observations and BFF attributes functional worker failure to the correct loop.
Static catalog provides only stable spec/owner contract; runtime maturity and health come from current records.
Evidence separates the retained prebuilt identity verifier from the stimulus-driven closure gate.

tasks.title: Retire replacement-proven backend duplicate owners and dead production paths
tasks.summary: Apply the final caller audit to Source, paper, Agora, loop truth, and Management backend paths after journeys pass.
acceptance: Caller/profile audit classifies every listed path keep, consolidate, retire-after-proof, or delete with evidence.

Automatic direct Agora dataset discovery, conflicting Source scheduler/profile, static paper runtime, full-scan lifecycle reader, and static loop runtime claims are removed when replacement proof exists.
Explicit manual Source one-shot and smoke/test fixtures remain clearly non-production when still needed.
All affected deployed/component journeys pass after deletion; no compatibility wrapper recreates the retired normal path.
code_disposition: This task is the backend disposition closeout; uncertain live callers stay retained with an explicit follow-up reason, not guessed deletion.
tasks.rollout: Remove one replacement-proven path at a time and rerun its journey.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the deletion commit if a real caller is found; do not restore duplicate authority design.

tasks.summary: Finish caller-based consolidation across Agora, Management, bff-v1, and legacy BFF adapters after browser proof.
acceptance: Production caller audit proves no page-local review drawer, fixed lens identity, synthetic panel, mock completed write, or strict-live seed fallback remains.
Active adapters converge toward one canonical live path; legacy modules with test/demo callers only are explicitly isolated.
Production build contains no seed import for audited surfaces while test fixtures remain usable.
Agora and Management browser journeys pass after consolidation and no compatibility shim recreates fake success.

tasks.rollout: Delete replacement-proven paths in small commits and rerun strict-live journeys.
tasks.rollback: Revert the specific deletion if a real caller exists; never restore synthetic production truth.

Source is reconcile-only before/after the named one-shot research run and has no recurring provider process.
Required L12, Agora, Management, and Management AI authenticated/browser journeys pass against the served pair with zero required skips.
